snippet.title: Away Team: Game Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://klei.gg/AwayTeam - A new game from Klei! Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included adventure. Take control of a Duplicant and harness a new world where every tile is simulated. 

Mistakenly shipped off on a research rocket, you find yourself in a strange new world where you must take control of the simulation to survive and thrive.

The world reacts to your every action. Harness chemical reactions, fine-grained temperature simulation and convection, liquids that evaporate, and more.

You will need to design and construct solutions to process, refine and build your way out of this ordeal in order to survive and complete your mission imperatives.

Oh, and maybe a little oxygen is included.

Wishlist on Steam: https://klei.gg/AwayTeam
